method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: Original insane refers the stance's mental-health exclusion, discriminatory language retained without invented diagnoses.
Original going to helping typo repaired in Chinese; Saudi refugee comparisons require definition/date context.
Original Jobs Syrian-refugee descendant assertion retained; father student immigrant vs refugee distinction pending primary biography research.
Original350 dollars retained, no silently inserted billion or changed numerical policy statement. Historical plan likely larger but source needed.
The Donald nickname rendered 那位唐纳德, no claim of particular author source or ordinary the determiner.
Walk the walk means acting on expressed policy, not campaign walk itinerary.
Convention floor means gathered delegates, not floor material.

revisions.source: We don't really plan to discuss this. I'd rather not be responsible for whatever Sanders might say.
revisions.zh: 我们其实不打算讨论这个。我不想为桑德斯可能说的话负责。

revisions.source: Donald Trump has repeatedly stepped over the line with his irresponsible rhetoric, and it shouldn't be any surprise that more and more protestors are turning out against him.
revisions.zh: 特朗普不负责任的言辞一再越界，越来越多抗议者站出来反对他，根本不奇怪。

revisions.source: Donald Trump's words go against everything our nation stands for, but I don't think it's correct or helpful to disrupt his rallies or to shout epithets at his supporters.
revisions.zh: 特朗普的话违背了我国所珍视的一切，但我不认为，打断他的集会或向他的支持者喊辱骂的话，是正确或有益的做法。

revisions.source: We shouldn't dignify Donald Trump's views with a debate. I will decline to participate in them.
revisions.zh: 我们不应该通过辩论，抬高特朗普观点的地位。我会拒绝参加。

revisions.source: Any chance we can get to expose Trump's complete lack of preparation for the Presidency is a win for us.
revisions.zh: 只要有机会揭露特朗普完全没准备好担任总统，对我们就是胜利。

revisions.source: Cory Booker is a bright, young, energetic man who will be perfectly ready to assume the Presidency from day one. He represents the best and brightest of the African-American community.
revisions.zh: 科里·布克聪明、年轻、精力充沛，从第一天起就完全准备好接任总统。他代表着非裔美国人社群中最优秀、最聪慧的人才。

revisions.source: The Second Amendment, people. I am a strong supporter of the Second Amendment.
revisions.zh: 各位，第二修正案。我坚定支持第二修正案。

revisions.source: I would only consider very minimal measures, to keep guns from the hands of the insane.
revisions.zh: 我只会考虑非常有限的措施，防止精神失常的人拿到枪。

revisions.source: I support common-sense measures to reduce gun violence in this country.
revisions.zh: 我支持采取符合常识的措施，减少本国枪支暴力。

revisions.source: We need to hold gun stores accountable when their weapons are used in violent crime. We need extensive measures to keep guns off the streets and away from criminals.
revisions.zh: 枪店出售的武器被用于暴力犯罪时，我们需要追究枪店的责任。我们需要广泛措施，让枪支远离街头、远离犯罪分子。

revisions.source: There are some very bad things happening right now. The last eight years have been a disaster for this country.
revisions.zh: 现在发生着一些非常糟糕的事。过去八年，对这个国家是一场灾难。

revisions.source: I'm proud that we were able to elect an African-American as President in this country. I really am. But we need to focus on the future now, and not on what may have gone right or wrong the last few years.
revisions.zh: 我国能选出一位非裔美国人担任总统，我很自豪，真的。但现在，我们需要聚焦未来，而不是过去几年可能做对或做错了什么。

revisions.source: I will be very proud to continue with the policies and economy that Obama has left our country with.
revisions.zh: 我将非常自豪地延续奥巴马给国家留下的政策与经济局面。

revisions.source: Abortion is a terrible, terrible thing. We need judges in this country that will see it that way, and end this practice once and for all.
revisions.zh: 堕胎是一件可怕、非常可怕的事。我国需要认同这一点的法官，彻底终结这种做法。

revisions.source: I'm a pro-life candidate. Very pro-life. I think only if a woman is in serious danger should she be able to receive an abortion.
revisions.zh: 我是反对堕胎的候选人。非常反对。我认为，只有女性面临严重危险时，才应该可以接受堕胎。

revisions.source: I will defend a woman's right to choose against any type of outside attack or meddling. We need to fight the recent attacks on abortion access.
revisions.zh: 我会捍卫女性的选择权，反对任何外来的攻击或干涉。我们需要抵抗近期对堕胎服务获取渠道的攻击。

revisions.source: I can't support it. You know, once upon a time we actually had a legislature in this country which debated the laws and made these kinds of decisions.
revisions.zh: 我无法支持。你知道，曾几何时，这个国家还真有一个立法机关，会辩论法律，作出这类决定。

revisions.source: I fully support gay marriage, but I'd like to see every state make this decision for itself.
revisions.zh: 我完全支持同性婚姻，但希望每个州自己作决定。

revisions.source: This decision was a milestone for equality in our country. I will appoint judges who feel the same way about it.
revisions.zh: 这项判决是我国平等事业的里程碑。我会任命对此持相同看法的法官。

revisions.source: You can't confirm him. We've got to let the people decide this November.
revisions.zh: 你们不能批准他的任命。我们必须让人民在今年十一月作决定。

revisions.source: This is congressional obstructionism at its worst. We've seen any number of judges be appointed in the final year of a term. We can't have what we're seeing right now.
revisions.zh: 这是国会阻挠政治最恶劣的表现。我们已经见过许多法官在总统任期最后一年获任命。我们不能接受眼下这种局面。

revisions.source: How about enforcing our current immigration law? We tried reform once already, and if it worked, we wouldn't even be discussing this now.
revisions.zh: 何不先执行现行移民法？我们已经尝试过一次改革；如果管用，现在根本就不会再讨论这个问题。

revisions.source: I'm not opposed to comprehensive immigration reform. We just need to build a wall first, and deport the people who have no right to be in the United States.
revisions.zh: 我不反对全面移民改革。但我们需要先修一堵墙，再遣返那些无权留在美国的人。

revisions.source: I believe this is a good policy, and I'm willing to make compromises in the area of immigration enforcement to build a working coalition.
revisions.zh: 我认为，这是好政策。我愿意在移民执法方面妥协，以建立一个能合作的联盟。

revisions.source: I will push for comprehensive immigration reform within 100 days of taking office. This will bring security to millions of families and make it harder for companies to exploit foreign workers.
revisions.zh: 我会在就职100天内推动全面移民改革。这将让数百万家庭安心，也让企业更难剥削外国劳动者。

revisions.source: The entire global warming alarm is a fantasy. A lot of people are pushing it so they can increase their own power and decision making.
revisions.zh: 所谓全球变暖警报，完全是幻想。许多人鼓吹它，只是为了扩大自己的权力和决策权限。

revisions.source: Even if global warming is real, I highly doubt it has anything to do with human activity.
revisions.zh: 即使全球变暖确实存在，我也非常怀疑它与人类活动有什么关系。

revisions.source: We need to encourage a healthy economy in general, so that green businesses can obtain the investment that they need to innovate.
revisions.zh: 我们需要总体上促进经济健康发展，让绿色企业得到创新所需的投资。

revisions.source: We need to extend our tax credits for green energy installations, and increase the amount of spending on research. We also need to take active steps to reduce carbon emissions.
revisions.zh: 我们需要延长绿色能源设施的税收抵免，并增加研究支出。也需要积极采取措施减少碳排放。

revisions.source: We're going to crack down on waste and fraud. There's a terrible amount of bad stuff going on out there.
revisions.zh: 我们要严厉打击浪费和欺诈。外头有太多糟糕透顶的事。

revisions.source: We need to constrain future spending increases and allow the economy to grow, which should make our debt more manageable over time.
revisions.zh: 我们需要限制未来支出增长，让经济发展；随着时间推移，债务就应该更容易管理。

revisions.source: We're going to support anyone in this country who tries to get a college education. We're going to protect Social Security and make sure our veterans are adequately cared for.
revisions.zh: 我们会支持本国每一个努力接受大学教育的人。我们要保护社会保障，确保退伍军人得到妥善照顾。

revisions.source: The European Union has been a complete disaster, and I can't blame any country, especially the United Kingdom, that would want out.
revisions.zh: 欧盟彻底失败了。任何想退出的国家，尤其英国，我都不能责怪。

revisions.source: We've all seen the issues with the European Union, and it obviously hasn't been perfect. But I'd hope that any country consider things very carefully before they decided to leave.
revisions.zh: 我们都看到了欧盟的问题，它显然并不完美。但我希望，任何国家在决定离开之前，都非常慎重地考虑。

revisions.source: We shouldn't be taking any refugees from Syria. We're talking about some very bad people here, who don't have America's interests at heart.
revisions.zh: 我们不应该接纳任何来自叙利亚的难民。这里说的可是一些非常糟糕的人，他们并不关心美国利益。

revisions.source: We'll take as many refugees as Saudi Arabia takes. And in any case, we're going to helping out with a safe zone in Syria to protect vulnerable people.
revisions.zh: 沙特阿拉伯接纳多少难民，我们就接纳多少。不管怎样，我们会帮助在叙利亚建立安全区，保护处境脆弱的人。

revisions.source: You know, Steve Jobs was a descendent of Syrian refugees. We're screening these people very carefully and we can certainly afford to take in more than 10,000.
revisions.zh: 你知道，史蒂夫·乔布斯是叙利亚难民的后代。我们正在非常仔细地筛查这些人，完全有能力接纳超过1万人。

revisions.source: College administrators are skimming an unbelievable amount of money off of the federal government, and they're using student aid to drive up tuition. It's a terrible thing, really.
revisions.zh: 大学管理者从联邦政府那里捞走了令人难以置信的大笔金钱，还利用学生资助抬高学费。真的，这太糟糕了。

revisions.source: We need a more balanced trade situation, so that we have jobs available to people at all levels of society. We've really done a disservice to the white and African-American working class over the past twenty years.
revisions.zh: 我们需要更平衡的贸易局面，让社会各阶层都有工作可做。过去二十年，我们实在辜负了白人和非裔美国劳动阶级。

revisions.source: I have a plan to spend $350 over the next 10 years to help those who need it the most, to attend college.
revisions.zh: 我计划在未来十年花费350美元，帮助那些最需要帮助的人上大学。

revisions.source: I will do everything in my power to make a four-year degree available without cost to the students of tomorrow.
revisions.zh: 我会尽我所能，让未来的学生无需付费，就能取得四年制大学学位。

revisions.source: Mr. Trump's gross and outlandish rhetoric should disgust any decent, hard-working women in our society. We need to show that there is no place for this rhetoric.
revisions.zh: 特朗普先生粗俗、离谱的言辞，应该让社会中每一位正派、勤奋的女性反感。我们需要表明，这种言辞没有立足之地。

revisions.source: Everybody knows about these kinds of statements. We shouldn't allow ourselves to be dragged into the gutter on this. Rather, we should focus on policy issues in our campaign.
revisions.zh: 大家都知道这些话。我们不应该被拖进这种低俗争吵，而应该在竞选中聚焦政策议题。

revisions.source: A lot of Democrats thought your answer was a bit snarky, though it does move you towards the center on immigration issues.
revisions.zh: 许多民主党人觉得你的回答有点刻薄，不过，它确实让你在移民问题上向中间靠了一些。

revisions.source: Can you get your story straight on the gay marriage position? There is already some latent suspicion of your commitment-level from the LGBT community.
revisions.zh: 你能把自己在同性婚姻问题上的立场说清楚、说一致吗？LGBT社群本来就对你的投入程度暗存疑虑。

revisions.source: Good luck tomorrow, and may you defeat The Donald!
revisions.zh: 祝你明天好运，愿你击败“那位唐纳德”！

revisions.source: It's not a big deal in this election, but there are some people who dislike Trump, yet are still uncomfortable with the tactics of these protestors.
revisions.zh: 这在本次选举中不是大事，但有些人虽然不喜欢特朗普，仍对这些抗议者的手法感到不安。

revisions.source: Just hit him on this as much as you can. It's a weak spot for him.
revisions.zh: 尽管抓住这点攻击他。这是他的弱点。

revisions.source: Most people seem to think that your debates were inconclusive and will have little effect on the race.
revisions.zh: 多数人似乎认为，辩论没有分出高下，对选情也不会有什么影响。

revisions.source: Needless to say, Obama is very popular among African-Americans and should help you maintain turnout in that demographic.
revisions.zh: 不用说，奥巴马在非裔美国人中非常受欢迎，应该能帮你维持这一群体的投票率。

revisions.source: People are surprised at your passive stance towards Trump.
revisions.zh: 人们对你如此被动地对待特朗普感到意外。

revisions.source: People certainly love Elizabeth Warren, but Sanders's relatively minimal role does not go unnoticed.
revisions.zh: 人们当然喜欢伊丽莎白·沃伦，但桑德斯的角色相对微不足道，也没有逃过大家的眼睛。

revisions.source: People wonder if you're using this position to hedge away from your college tuition plan.
revisions.zh: 人们怀疑，你是否借这个立场，给自己的大学学费计划留退路。

revisions.source: Progressives are pleased to see your anti-TPP position carry over into the general election.
revisions.zh: 进步派很高兴看到，你反对TPP的立场延续到了大选。

revisions.source: Progressives are starting to believe that you really walk the walk on TPP. Behind the scenes, Obama is not pleased with you, however.
revisions.zh: 进步派开始相信，你在TPP问题上确实说到做到。不过，私下里奥巴马对你并不高兴。

revisions.source: Sanders brings the convention floor to its feet, helping to define the Democrats as a staunchly progressive party.
revisions.zh: 桑德斯让大会全场起立，帮助将民主党塑造成一个坚定的进步派政党。

revisions.source: Statements like this are a bit tone-deaf in the 2016 environment.
revisions.zh: 在2016年的环境下，这种表态有点不懂民情。

revisions.source: The debates went well for you. Trump looked a little out of his depth on a few occasions.
revisions.zh: 辩论对你很有利。特朗普有几次显得力不从心。

revisions.source: The protests, when they get to a certain level, seem to help Trump more than hurt him. But many progressives don't like to hear you distance yourself like this.
revisions.zh: 抗议达到一定程度时，似乎对特朗普帮助多于伤害。但许多进步派不喜欢听到你这样与抗议者划清界限。

revisions.source: The Republican position in Congress is not supported by most of the public.
revisions.zh: 国会共和党的立场，没有得到多数公众支持。
